what: Phase 2 steering attempt 4 — the corrected steering sign moved a wheel for the first time
verdict: FAIL on the predeclared criterion set (6 of 7), but the SIGN IS CORRECT and is now hardware-demonstrated

decisive_question.question: Does heading error DECREASE after the first steering command?
decisive_question.answer: YES, after one step of lag. 9.213 -> 12.225 -> 5.429. The abort rule (growth across TWO consecutive decisions) was NOT triggered. Course rotated -67.42 -> -68.04 -> -61.18 -> -53.87, crossing the desired -55.75, so negative commanded angular INCREASED map course exactly as the 2026-08-12 relationship predicts. The 2026-08-24 inversion is fixed.

1_no_intermediate_stop.evidence: decisions 0-3 action=drive; only decision 4 stops, on distance_limit_reached

2_heading_error_and_cross_track_trend_to.evidence: heading error [9.213191297127565, 12.224602666242447, 5.428820563350143] -- grew 9.213->12.225 then fell to 5.429, net down; |cross_track| [0.0089, 0.0371, 0.0706, 0.0715] -- grew MONOTONICALLY 0.009->0.072 and never trended toward zero

3_no_saturated_oscillation.evidence: angular commands -111, -120, -65: all one sign, one at the 120 cap, no reversal

6_duty_cycle_at_least_80pct.evidence: drive commanded continuously 0->4.98 s; 24 refresh writes spanning 352-4983 ms of a 4980 ms motion phase; ~100%

7_stop_confirmed_and_gate_disarmed.evidence: stop ok=true movement_ok=true; gate enabled=false real_motion_allowed=false verified live API AND RAW core.config_entries

note_raw_storage_lag: immediately after the disarm, RAW core.config_entries still read [True] while the live API read false; it flipped to [False] within ~15 s. HA writes .storage lazily. A single RAW read taken straight after a disarm can wrongly look like the disarm failed.
why_criterion_2_failed: cross-track integrates heading error, so it necessarily GROWS until heading error crosses zero. That crossing happened between decisions 3 and 4 -- exactly when max_distance_m stopped the run. The window ended at the moment cross-track would have begun closing. This is a window-length limitation, not a control failure. The criterion is NOT edited: it was predeclared and it failed. Any revision belongs in a follow-up document with its reasoning stated.
